cases.name: terraform_plan_with_each_kind_of_mark
cases.description: A plan with a declared sensitive attribute, a value known only after the deployment, a sensitive variable and output, provider settings, a provisioner and a configured resource with no instance: the marks and anchors its reader gives, and the plan redacted with them under a policy that hides tags.owner.

cases.name: terraform_plan_with_rendering_metadata_and_a_sensitive_value_copied_where_it_is_not_marked
cases.description: A plan rendered at a time, from a prior state, whose declared sensitive variable the provider also copied into tags_all, which the plan does not mark sensitive: the kept plan hides that copy as a reuse of a sensitive value, and its digest drops the rendering metadata.

cases.name: terraform_plan_with_a_sensitive_object_output_copied_unmarked
cases.description: A plan whose sensitive object output holds a string a planned resource also holds unmarked: every string inside the output's value, in planned_values and in output_changes, is hidden wherever it appears.

cases.name: terraform_plan_with_a_planned_resource_that_names_no_sensitive_values
cases.description: Refused: a resource of planned_values with no sensitive_values key, which the tool writes for every resource.
cases.refused: every resource names its sensitive values, as the tool writes them; the resource at planned_values.root_module.resources[0] names none

cases.name: terraform_plan_with_a_sensitive_object_variable_copied_unmarked
cases.description: A plan whose sensitive root variable is an object holding a string a planned resource also holds unmarked: every string inside the variable's value is hidden wherever it appears.

cases.name: terraform_plan_holding_a_planted_redaction_marker
cases.description: Refused: a plan that already holds a whole redaction marker in a value.
cases.refused: the plan holds an object at resource_changes[0].change.after.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes

cases.name: terraform_plan_holding_a_planted_unknown_marker
cases.description: Refused: a plan that already holds a whole unknown marker in a value.
cases.refused: the plan holds an object at resource_changes[0].change.after.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes

cases.name: terraform_plan_holding_a_marker_lookalike
cases.description: Refused: a plan that already holds an object with the redaction marker's key and other keys in a value.
cases.refused: the plan holds an object at resource_changes[0].change.after.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes
